firstPlayerRule: Each player draws a random Level 1 ship during setup. Whoever draws the highest sector number takes the starting-player card and goes first.
officialTieBreak: Players tied for the highest sector number roll the dice; the highest total goes first.
houseFallback: If tied players also tie for the highest dice total, have those players reroll.
clarifications: Buy and install the drawn ship as instructed during setup. Turns proceed clockwise.
